gaps.sentence: We should make the ___ of the good weather.
gaps.explanation: 'make the most of' = get the maximum benefit from.

gaps.sentence: He ran so fast that we lost ___ of him.
gaps.explanation: 'lose sight of somebody' = no longer see them.

gaps.sentence: She went to university ___ study law.
I'd better not ___ you — you look busy.
She denied ___ the last piece of cake.
It was ___ dull a lecture that people walked out.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective (+a + noun) + that… — the alternative emphatic pattern.

gaps.sentence: We're going to ___ our flight if we don't hurry.
gaps.hint: be too late for a plane
gaps.explanation: 'miss a flight/train/bus' = arrive too late for it.
